purpose: Can the 262144-token context fit VRAM with IQ2_XS on the Arc Pro B70?
reference: usable VRAM 31.92 GiB; n=12 device-lost at 31.85 GiB during a 128K prefill (expert-placement.md)

cases.label: ctx256-q8-n16
cases.verdict: unsafe; within ~0.03 GiB of the 31.85 GiB device-loss threshold

cases.label: ctx256-q8-n18
cases.verdict: safe; ~1.5 GiB margin; keeps KV at q8

cases.label: ctx256-q4-n16
cases.verdict: safe; ~1.75 GiB margin; loses KV precision

run_protocol: start llama-server, wait for 'model loaded', read /proc/<pid>/fdinfo drm-resident-vram0, send one 4-token request, read VRAM again, stop. A full 262144-token prefill was NOT run (~30+ min).
